snippet.title: New QBIX Game | Mummy Twist
snippet.description:
Introducing the newest QBIX game, launched at IAAPA: Mummy Twist is player-approved and ready to take adventurers on a wild ride! In this treasure hunt, players must solve puzzles, match symbols, and dodge the guardian of the temples - the Mummy - all while racing against the clock. Who's brave enough to take on the challenge?

Learn more about QBIX here: https://inowize.com/qbix/ and check out its current game gallery here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v8yyRCLRTIY&t=2s. 

QBIX is a self-service, 6-player immersive game room manufactured by Inowize. It offers a wide range of fun and multi-sensory games in a 13x13 ft space, with 5D effects like wind blasts and a motion floor.
